messages:
maria: kicking off async-ingest dedupe + sampler handshake for new model bringup. planning a small golden refresh after quant smoke. hitting owners: @eli @sam :eyes:

eli: copying notes — what's target size for sampler and golden? we have 5k new candidates from collector.

maria: target sampler 800 per shard (4 shards) -> 3200. golden refresh 250 prioritized edgecases + 50 regression probes. need label bandwidth.

sam: I can spare 3 labelers Tue/Wed. labelers to focus on instruction-following failures and hallucinations.

nisha: FYI dedupe will use simhash + lexicographic normalization. False positives around short Q/A. adding bloom filter pre-check to save compute.

eli: can you paste the pipeline command? want to reproduce the dedupe locally.

nisha: ```bash
python ingest/dedupe_run.py --input s3://redwood-ingest/new-model-2003 --shards 4 --simhash-k=64 --bloom-p=0.001 --out s3://redwood-curation/deduped-2003456789
```

jin: quick question: will quant bench use fp16 or int8 for the first pass? int8 to mimic production but need to watch prompt truncation.

maria: run both. primary bench int8-qat (prod-like). secondary fp16 to measure quality delta. use same prompt bank. store embeddings for fingerprint check.

label-bot: reminder: label queue "ingest-dupcheck" created. 3 open tasks. :bell:

sam: plan for golden relabel: I'll send a short spreadsheet with priority tags (high/med/low). we'll iterate grooming Thu.

eli: can ops add temporary logging at the sampler stage? need token-level length histogram and coverage by prompt-type.

ops-bot: ops note: temp logging enabled on node-pool-a for 4 hours starting 2026-03-21T02:00Z. :white_check_mark:

maria: timeline: dedupe + sampler run today, label handoff tomorrow, quant smoke Wed, golden refresh Thu. blockers?

nisha: potential blocker: simhash threshold tuned for english only; need to widen for multi-lingual samples. I'll drop a param tweak by EOD.

sam: no blockers from team. :thumbsup: 

eli: I'll watch bench runs and push metrics to the model-onboard dashboard.

maria: thanks — keep thread updated with s3 URIs and sample counts. I'll post final golden manifest when ready. :sparkles:
